title: Enter… The Droid Factory
front_description: While Chancellor Palpatine is granted emergency powers by the Galactic Senate on Coruscant, Anakin and Padmé arrive on Geonosis and enter the seemingly deserted corridors of a stalagmite city. As they walk, the winged Geonosians begin detaching from the surrounding pillars and savagely attack! Fighting them off, the duo race ahead and find themselves on the edge of a short walkway over a deep crevasse.
back_description: The actors walk past a blue screen, soon to become a Geonosian corridor.
